verified_defects.what: After the exam (GET /api/plan state 'after', exam yesterday) the selected day is clamped to exam_date, whose kind is 'exam'. The eve/exam branch runs before the 'after' branch, so the page says 'SAT today · good luck' and resultPanel() never renders. There is no way to record the result, so §3.6.8 #26 fails (a:v2verfin01: no input, 'SAT was Sat, Sep 26').
verified_defects.fix: Test `S.d.state === 'after' && day.date >= cfg().exam_date` before the eve/exam branch, or render resultPanel() for the exam day once state is 'after'.

verified_defects.what: The rule `.pl .cal.plan.compact .cal-meta { display: none }` hides each day's minutes in the wizard's live month grid (and in the landing's ready panel). The markup has `45m`, but the cells' visible text is only '28', '29', '30'. So §3.6.8 #22 ('Calendar cells show their minutes text') and plan.md L1 acceptance 4 (the 1h chip changes week 1's cells to '1h' within 400 ms) both fail.
verified_defects.fix: Remove .cal-meta from that selector (keep .cal-own and .cal-phase hidden if intended), so compact plan calendars show the minutes.

verified_defects.what: Native Element.append/replaceChildren get a null argument (`studyLeft ? h(...) : null`, `notes.length ? h(...) : null`) and insert the literal text 'null'. It shows in the Days-to-exam tile ('SAT was Sat, Sep 26 null') and in the Coming up card ('No more study days before the SAT.null') whenever no study days are left: the eve, exam day and after. Also, after the exam that tile's aria-label reads '-1 days to the SAT'.
verified_defects.fix: Filter falsy children before native append/replaceChildren, or build these nodes with UI.h, which skips null. Scan the other native append calls in plan.js for the same pattern. Clamp or reword the aria-label once state is 'after'.

verified_defects.what: The Plans tab shows 5 plans and a 'Show all N' button. The upgrade acceptance says 25 plans show 20 rows and 'Show 20 more · 5 left', and 12 plans show 12 rows with no pager. Seen with a:v2verpager01 (25 plans): 5 rows, no 'Show 20 more'.
verified_defects.fix: Start S.shown at 20. The button reads `Show 20 more · ${plans.length - S.shown} left` and adds 20; hide it when every plan is shown.

verified_defects.where: server/plan.py payload for learners with no active plan (sittings, rhythm and points are only added in the active branch, ~lines 2021-2040): a server change for the other agent, not the pages
verified_defects.what: A learner with no active plan gets only active/bank/draft/plans/proposal. So the new-plan wizard's step 1 score bar has no bands and no average mark (plan.md L2 acceptance 1), step 3 has no 'Last 4 weeks' / 'You've averaged' line (L2 acceptance 3), and step 4 shows the 'Where your points are' placeholder. With ?edit=<id> the same learner data gives 2 bands + 1 average mark and 'You've averaged 1h 48m a week', so the pages are right and only degrade.
verified_defects.fix: Have GET /api/plan include sittings, rhythm and points (math) when there is no active plan.

verified_defects.what: The why lines are folded behind a 'Why' button with aria-expanded=false. plan.md L10 acceptance 7 and the brief's phone layout note say they render open on load. Decision 7 (details on demand) is newer and wins, so this is probably intended.
verified_defects.fix: Have the main session confirm decision 7 overrides L10 acceptance 7; if not, render the list open by default.

verified_defects.what: With R&W unset, step 1 shows 'Not set · your Total needs it' and an 'Add my R&W score' button, not the R&W slider that L20 acceptance 6 expects. This fits decision 7 (hide defaults, one tap away).
verified_defects.fix: Confirm decision 7 governs this; otherwise show the slider when R&W is unset.

verified_defects.what: After the exam the Score tile still shows the server's pace line 'Needs +910 a week' (verdict.needs_per_week) and 'Behind · 112', which make no sense once the SAT is over.
verified_defects.fix: Hide the pace and behind lines when S.d.state === 'after', or ask the server to return a null verdict after the exam.

verified_defects.what: No S7 file reads or writes sessionStorage satf.return, and 'Back to your plan' exists nowhere under web/. The report side is not S7's, so the item can't pass until someone owns both halves.
verified_defects.fix: Agree the contract: S7 sets satf.return to a same-origin /plan/ path when it sends a student to a test or diagnostic, and the report page shows 'Back to your plan' only for same-origin paths.

verified_defects.what: The calendar marks the chosen cell with aria-selected=true (correct for role=gridcell), not the aria-pressed=true the acceptance text names. The behaviour works.
verified_defects.fix: Read #28 as aria-selected; no page change needed.
